Aphelios.combo: After one basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet and immediately land the next attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so Aphelios is hit by its return path too. When engaging with your team, activate Sivir R On The Hunt and keep basic attacking to get your basic abilities back sooner.
Aphelios.escape: The chance to engage comes after you dodge Aphelios’s Gravitum root or block it with Sivir E Spell Shield. While Aphelios doesn’t have Severum, Flash is his only way to escape, so look to close the distance with your team. Sivir has no escape ability either, so don’t move into range where you can be caught first.
Aphelios.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to Aphelios. Spread out from your team so Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil doesn’t hit multiple allies, and activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team signals an engage or retreat. After activating it, keep basic attacking from a safe distance to get opportunities to use Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet again sooner.
Aphelios.build: Finish one core item first, then prioritize armor against Aphelios’s physical damage. If his healing prolongs fights, buy Executioner's Calling after building armor. Sivir W Ricochet can spread Grievous Wounds to multiple enemies.
Aphelios.fight: Trade briefly while Aphelios has a weapon with low burst damage. Hit with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, then reposition with the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to manage the distance. If you block Aphelios’s root with Sivir E Spell Shield, counterattack as soon as you gain the heal and movement speed.
Aphelios.laning: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so hold it when you don’t have a good angle to hit. To push the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then line up Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s outbound and return paths with the minion wave. If Aphelios marks you with a Calibrum shot, back off to preserve your health, and don’t use Sivir E Spell Shield just because he looks like he’s setting up a root.
Aphelios.phase: Early on, manage Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s mana cost and choose whether to fight based on Aphelios’s weapon. Mid game is Sivir’s siege window, with attack speed and critical strike, so push waves and pressure turrets with your team.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with a Gravitum basic attack, watch for the root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. Once you see the slow applied, immediately move out of range and save Sivir E Spell Shield until you need to block the root. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil deals more damage when it hits multiple champions, so spread out from your team before engaging.

Draven.laning: If early trades are unfavorable, farm safely and don’t give Draven a kill. If Draven walks forward to follow a pushed-in lane, that creates an opening for your jungler. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so use it carefully when you can aim for both an axe landing spot and the wave.
Draven.phase: Early on, focus on avoiding trades against Draven’s two Draven Q Spinning Axe and on not giving him a kill. In mid game, make use of Sivir’s fast wave clear, siege, and team movement with Sivir R On The Hunt.
Draven.build: Draven’s primary damage is physical, so build armor first. Keep enough health to stay out of the execute threshold for Draven R Whirling Death, and consider an attack speed reduction option to reduce the damage he relies on from basic attacks and attack speed.
Draven.combo: Throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade where Draven’s axe will land, then move to the side so he can get hit by the return path even if he dodges the outbound blade. If he has one or fewer axes and you can fight, make a short trade in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. After damaging a champion, reposition with the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot.
Draven.escape: Close the distance when Draven E Stand Aside is down and Draven Q Spinning Axe is at one or fewer axes. Draven can gain movement speed from Draven W Blood Rush, so when your team goes in together, Sivir R On The Hunt is a good way to add movement speed.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight Draven while he has two axes. Throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade where his axe will land to pressure him into giving it up or taking damage. When he has one or fewer axes, land a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet, and immediately land the next attack.
Draven.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team engages or retreats, and if the fight continues, basic attack champions to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. Don’t stay in the return path of Draven R Whirling Death.
Draven.watch: Avoid early basic attack trades while Draven has two Draven Q Spinning Axe. Draven E Stand Aside can knock you back or pull you and slow you, so use Sivir E Spell Shield when it actually flies toward you. After dodging Draven R Whirling Death once, get out of its return path too, and move out of range if your health is low.

Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches farther than its indicator suggests, so don’t stand in a straight line behind a minion he’s attacking. When Lucian R The Culling starts, dodge sideways instead of running straight back. Don’t use Sivir E Spell Shield early when the enemy only feints an engage; save it for when a root or stun ability actually flies toward you.
Lucian.build: Buy armor first against the damage from Lucian Q Piercing Light and Lucian R The Culling. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Lucian W Ardent Blaze, but armor is the priority against his main sources of damage.
Lucian.combo: If Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down and you’ve avoided his first combo, attack in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Activating Sivir W Ricochet resets your basic attack timer, so don’t activate it in advance. Follow with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move sideways to try to hit Lucian on its return path too.
Lucian.escape: The brief window to close the distance is right after you make Lucian use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit. Counterattack if the enemy’s root or stun ability is down or you blocked it with Sivir E Spell Shield. After blocking it, make use of healing and the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot.
Lucian.fight: Wait out Lucian’s initial burst, then trade when his abilities are down. Close the distance right after Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, and don’t let him prolong basic attack trades and get that ability back sooner. Right after damaging him with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to reposition.
Lucian.laning: When Lucian uses Lucian Q Piercing Light on a minion, move out of the line behind that minion. If the enemy support shields or heals Lucian, or an ally is immobilized, take a step back instead of facing his next two empowered shots. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t throw it carelessly. When pushing the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then clear with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade.
Lucian.phase: Early on, watch out for Lucian’s explosive first combo, save mana for Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, and manage the wave. Sivir’s midgame siege phase peaks when she has attack speed and critical strike, so push the wave and pressure towers with your allies.
Lucian.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send damage to the back line. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to match your allies’ engage or retreat, then keep basic attacking champions to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. If Lucian R The Culling has an angle to hit you, move sideways out of its line of aim.

Smolder.build: Sivir's physical damage is effective against Smolder, who has low armor. If his healing becomes a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after completing one core item. If you need more resistances, consider armor first, but resistances cannot block the true damage from Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath.
Smolder.combo: When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, trade briefly with a basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so Smolder is also hit by its return path.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so immediately after he uses it is your chance to engage. If you also dodge Smolder W Achooo!, you can chase him while reducing the risk of being slowed and caught.
Smolder.fight: Bait out Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap early, then close the distance and attack. Hit him with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, then keep moving and hit him with Q on its return as well.
Smolder.laning: Pressure Smolder while avoiding his poke and making it hard for him to farm CS, slowing the growth of Smolder P Dragon Practice. Hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet and line up Sivir Q Boomerang Blade with the minion wave to clear it, but if you don't want to push the lane, activate W without hitting any minions.
Smolder.phase: Pressure Smolder aggressively early, before he builds up growth stacks. In the mid game, use Sivir's fast wave clear and Sivir R On The Hunt to help your team take down towers and objectives. Smolder gets stronger as the game goes on, so fight with your team rather than dueling alone in the late game.
Smolder.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to carry damage through to their backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team's engage or retreat, and keep basic attacking during the fight to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and W.
Smolder.watch: Smolder W Achooo! slows you and makes you easier to hit with follow-up attacks, so stand behind minions or dodge to the side. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so move out of its area, then re-engage.

Nilah.fight: Damage Nilah from beyond her reach with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and basic attacks, then immediately reposition using the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot. While Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, use Sivir Q Boomerang Blade instead of basic attacks or wait for the veil to end. Fight in coordination with your allies’ crowd control after Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil are down.
Nilah.build: Build armor first and get some health too against the physical damage from Nilah Q Formless Blade, Nilah E Slipstream, and Nilah R Apotheosis. Nilah Q Formless Blade has penetration, so armor alone won’t solve the problem.
Nilah.combo: After Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends, make a short trade in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Activating Sivir W Ricochet resets your basic attack timer, so don’t activate it before your first basic attack. After throwing Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, move sideways so Nilah is also hit on its return path.
Nilah.escape: Keep your distance while Nilah uses Nilah E Slipstream to engage, and look for an opening after Nilah E Slipstream and Nilah W Jubilant Veil have been fully spent. Nilah E Slipstream can be used again after a short interval, so don’t stay close for long relying only on that opening. Time Sivir R On The Hunt with your allies’ engage or retreat.
Nilah.laning: When pushing the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then finish the wave with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so throw it along a path where it can hit. If you don’t want to push, don’t hit minions while Sivir W Ricochet is active.
Nilah.phase: In the midgame, use Sivir’s fast wave clear and Sivir R On The Hunt to siege with your allies.
Nilah.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send damage through to the back line. When Nilah R Apotheosis is available, spread out from your allies; if several of you have already been pulled in, attack Nilah immediately with your allies. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to match your allies’ engage or retreat, then keep basic attacking after engaging to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
Nilah.watch: Watch for Nilah E Slipstream to close the distance, and step farther back beyond Nilah Q Formless Blade’s increased range after it hits. Stop basic attacking while Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, since your basic attacks will miss. Spread out so multiple allies aren’t pulled in by Nilah R Apotheosis.

Ashe.combo: After Ashe W Volley is down, make a short trade in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Sivir W Ricochet resets your basic attack timer when activated, so use it right after the first attack. After throwing Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, move to the side to try to catch Ashe with its return path too.
Ashe.escape: You have a chance to close the distance after Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow misses or is blocked by Sivir E Spell Shield, and Ashe W Volley is down. If Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, back away until it expires, then go in. Ashe has no mobility ability, but Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow keeps refreshing, so don’t spend too long walking toward her within her basic attack range.
Ashe.fight: Trade after Ashe W Volley is down and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has expired. Hit with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, then adjust your distance as you move. Ashe has no way to create distance on her own, so if you can reach her, activate Sivir W Ricochet right after a basic attack and immediately land the next one.
Ashe.laning: Dodge Ashe W Volley to the side, and don’t stay within Ashe’s basic attack range for long because Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow is refreshed with each attack. Don’t spend Sivir E Spell Shield on poke; save it for when Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow flies toward you. To push the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then line up Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s outbound and return paths with the minion wave.
Ashe.phase: Early on, watch out for Ashe W Volley poke and the damage she deals while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t throw it needlessly; make use of your fast wave clear.
Ashe.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team signals an engage or retreat, then keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. If Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow is ready, don’t start a small fight from out of vision; watch for the right moment to block the arrow with Sivir E Spell Shield when it flies toward you.
Ashe.watch: Dodge Ashe W Volley, an area slow, by moving to the side of its cone. When Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, back away from her empowered basic attacks. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow can stun you, so change direction to dodge it; if you’re about to be hit, use Sivir E Spell Shield when the arrow actually flies.

Caitlyn.build: Prioritize tenacity to reduce the root duration from Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, and movement speed to close the distance. When building resistances, get armor to match Caitlyn’s primary damage.
Caitlyn.combo: Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so Caitlyn is hit by its return path too.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid the path of Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, and time Sivir E Spell Shield to block it if you’re at risk of being rooted. If you’re unsure, don’t use Sivir E Spell Shield early; back away.
Caitlyn.fight: Right after Caitlyn clears the wave with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, hit her with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, then reposition with the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot.
Caitlyn.laning: While Caitlyn is strong early, don’t overextend and give her a kill; farm under your turret. To push the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then line up Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s outbound and return paths with the minion wave. When you don’t want to push, don’t hit minions while Sivir W Ricochet is active.
Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong in the early laning phase, so farm safely.
Caitlyn.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team engages or retreats, then keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. If an ally is targeted by Caitlyn R Ace in the Hole, you can step into the bullet’s path and block it for them.
Caitlyn.watch: If Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap roots you, Caitlyn P Headshot can deal heavy damage from its increased range, so avoid bushes and narrow paths. When Caitlyn pokes with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind allied minions so they get hit first.

Ezreal.build: First, get movement speed to help close the distance. Ezreal deals both physical and magic damage, so don’t focus on just one resistance; also consider an option that reduces attack speed.
Ezreal.combo: After Ezreal E Arcane Shift is down, make a short attack in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so its return path also catches Ezreal.
Ezreal.escape: The opening to go in comes right after you make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift.
Ezreal.fight: Trade short bursts of damage while dodging Ezreal Q Mystic Shot from behind minions. Make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then use Sivir R On The Hunt to close the distance with your team.
Ezreal.laning: Move along the inside of the wave so minions block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot. To push the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then clear with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t throw it when you don’t have a good angle to hit.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, block Ezreal’s poke with minions, conserve mana when using Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, and manage the lane. Sivir is strong in the mid game siege window, so push waves and pressure turrets with your team.
Ezreal.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team engages or retreats, and keep basic attacking during the fight to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. Don’t just trade poke with Ezreal from long range; use vision and an angle to engage to close the distance.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot by keeping minions between you and him. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range before his next basic attack or ability can hit. When your health is low, move back at an angle to avoid the straight-line path of Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage.

Jhin.build: Jhin’s primary damage is physical, so build armor first. Sivir’s physical damage is effective against Jhin’s relatively low armor, and in mid game make use of your siege window with attack speed and critical strike.
Jhin.combo: While Jhin reloads, land a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet, and immediately land the next attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so Jhin is hit by its return path too. If Jhin W Deadly Flourish flies toward you, block it with Sivir E Spell Shield and continue your counterattack.
Jhin.escape: Go in when Jhin W Deadly Flourish is down or Jhin is reloading. Jhin has no skill to create distance on his own, so use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to close the gap. Delay the engage if Jhin has his final bullet ready or Sivir E Spell Shield is down.
Jhin.fight: Back away if Jhin has his final bullet ready, and close the distance while he reloads or right after he fires one or two shots. If you hit him with a basic attack to gain the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, reposition as you attack; if Jhin W Deadly Flourish flies toward you, block it with Sivir E Spell Shield and counterattack.
Jhin.laning: Stand a step away from low-health minions to avoid Jhin Q Dancing Grenade bouncing to you with increased damage. To push the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade along the minion wave. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so use it when you can see a path to hit.
Jhin.phase: Early on, watch out for Jhin’s final bullet and conserve mana when using Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Mid game, when Sivir has attack speed and critical strike, is her peak siege window, so push waves and pressure turrets with your team.
Jhin.teamfight: From your team’s backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team engages or retreats, and if the fight continues, land basic attacks to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. Jhin R Curtain Call is more dangerous when your health is low, so dodge the shots if you aren’t at full health.
Jhin.watch: When Jhin Q Dancing Grenade kills a target as it bounces, its next hit becomes stronger, so don’t stand next to a low-health minion. Right after being hit by Jhin’s basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience, watch for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish: move out of its straight path and use Sivir E Spell Shield when it flies toward you. When health is low, dodge Jhin R Curtain Call, especially the final shot.

Jinx.build: Mid game, when Sivir has attack speed and critical strike, is her strong window. If you need defenses, prioritize armor against Jinx’s primary physical damage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Jinx E Flame Chompers!.
Jinx.combo: If you block the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers! with Sivir E Spell Shield, counterattack as soon as you gain the heal and movement speed. Land a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet to reset your attack timer, then immediately attack again. After throwing Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, move to the side to threaten Jinx with its return path too.
Jinx.escape: You have a chance to engage when the slow from Jinx W Zap! misses or Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down. Jinx has no skill to create distance on her own, so use Sivir R On The Hunt to close the distance with your team.
Jinx.fight: When Jinx pokes with rockets, she doesn’t have minigun attack speed stacks, so trade a short burst of damage. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! misses or has already been used, close the distance and hit with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, then reposition with the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot.
Jinx.laning: When Jinx attacks minions with rockets, position yourself so you don’t overlap with them. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so throw it when you have a good angle to hit; to push the wave, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then clear with Q. When you don’t want to push, don’t hit minions while W is active.
Jinx.phase: Early on, look for an opening before Jinx builds minigun attack speed stacks, but conserve mana when using Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Mid game is Sivir’s siege window with attack speed and critical strike, so push waves and pressure turrets with your team.
Jinx.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team engages or retreats, and look to engage when Jinx W Zap! or Jinx E Flame Chompers! is down. After activating R, keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and W.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets deal damage around minions too, so don’t stand next to a minion when Jinx farms. Watch out for the slow from Jinx W Zap! and the root from Jinx E Flame Chompers!, and time Sivir E Spell Shield to block the root. If health has dropped, get out of range where Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket! can finish you off.

Kaisa.build: Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and basic attacks. Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker can’t be blocked by armor, so if you need to survive for a long time, also get magic resistance and health.
Kaisa.combo: Right after hitting Kai'Sa with a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet and immediately land the next attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so Kai'Sa is hit by its return path too. If you activated Sivir R On The Hunt while fighting with your team, keep basic attacking to get Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet back sooner.
Kaisa.escape: Kai'Sa can gain movement speed or become invisible with Kai'Sa E Supercharge, so don’t overextend to chase her alone. The provided material doesn’t identify an opening when Kai'Sa’s crowd control is down.
Kaisa.fight: Trade briefly with Sivir’s physical damage while Kai'Sa has low armor early. Trigger Sivir P Fleet of Foot with a basic attack, then reposition; when Kai'Sa looks ready to use Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain, stay near allied minions. If Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is down, look for a chance to engage with your team using Sivir R On The Hunt.
Kaisa.laning: Hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then finish the wave with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, but don’t waste Q because it costs a lot of mana. When you don’t want to push the lane, don’t hit minions while W is active.
Kaisa.phase: In mid game, use Sivir’s siege window with attack speed and critical strike to push waves and pressure turrets with your team.
Kaisa.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt when your team engages or retreats, then keep basic attacking. If Kai'Sa dives in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, respond to the engage with your team instead of overcommitting to chase while she has a shield.
Kaisa.watch: If Kai'Sa W Void Seeker hits you, its mark can let Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct dash in. Block W with Sivir E Spell Shield as it flies toward you; if it hits, retreat toward your team until the mark disappears. When your health is low and Kai'Sa P Second Skin stacks build up, wait out of range for the stacks to expire.

Kalista.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend. Kalista W Sentinel deals magic damage based on your maximum health, so be careful about choosing items that only add health.
Kalista.combo: Throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade as Kalista begins her basic attack windup, then move sideways after throwing it so she also gets hit on its return path. After a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet and immediately land another basic attack. Use Sivir E Spell Shield when Kalista Q Pierce actually flies toward you.
Kalista.escape: Look for a chance to engage with your allies when Kalista R Fate’s Call is down. Kalista P Martial Poise requires a basic attack animation to hop, so hit her during that animation with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and use Sivir R On The Hunt to help your allies engage.
Kalista.fight: When Kalista starts a basic attack, throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and try to catch her during her hop. After landing Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to adjust your distance. Keep trades short before she can stack several spears.
Kalista.laning: Hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then clear the wave with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t throw it at Kalista repeatedly without good reason. If Kalista has stacked spears on you and your health is low, leave lane until the spears disappear.
Kalista.phase: Early on, watch for Kalista’s basic attacks and Kalista E Rend stacks, and keep trades short. Sivir is strong during the midgame siege phase, when she has attack speed and critical strike, so push the wave and pressure towers with your allies.
Kalista.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send damage to the back line. If you see Kalista R Fate’s Call about to throw her support, spread out. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to match your allies’ engage or retreat, then keep basic attacking from a safe distance.
Kalista.watch: Block Kalista Q Pierce with Sivir E Spell Shield as it flies toward you. If Kalista’s basic attacks stack several spears, the damage and slow from Kalista E Rend become dangerous, so don’t keep fighting with stacks built up. If Kalista’s support moves in close, watch for Kalista R Fate’s Call and spread out.

KogMaw.build: Build magic resistance first against the magic damage from Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle, Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage, and Kog'Maw E Void Ooze. His basic attacks also deal significant physical damage, so get some armor too, but avoid relying on health alone because of Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage.
KogMaw.combo: After Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires, land a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet, then immediately land another basic attack. Follow with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move sideways so Kog'Maw also gets hit on its return path.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility, so avoid the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze; the window after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires is your chance to close the distance. Trigger Sivir P Fleet of Foot with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to reposition, and use Sivir R On The Hunt to increase movement speed when your allies engage with you.
KogMaw.fight: Close the distance and start trading after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires. Block Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle with minions or dodge it; if it’s hard to avoid, block it with Sivir E Spell Shield. After landing Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to reposition.
KogMaw.laning: Don’t force a fight while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active. After it expires, push the minions to pressure his farming. To clear the wave, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade through the minion line. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so save it when there’s no path along which it can hit.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, look for openings after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires and push the lane to disrupt his farming. In the midgame, use Sivir’s fast wave clear and Sivir R On The Hunt to pressure towers and objectives with your allies.
KogMaw.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send the bouncing damage to Kog'Maw in the back line. Use Sivir R On The Hunt when your allies engage on Kog'Maw or retreat, then keep basic attacking to use Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet more often. If you kill Kog'Maw, immediately move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and percent maximum health damage increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces your armor and magic resistance if it hits, so stand behind minions or dodge to the side. When your health is low, watch out for Kog'Maw R Living Artillery, which deals more damage, and move out of vision. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.

MissFortune.build: Build armor first because Miss Fortune’s main damage from Miss Fortune P Love Tap, Miss Fortune Q Double Up, and Miss Fortune R Bullet Time is physical. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. The information provided isn’t enough to determine a specific first purchase.
MissFortune.combo: For a short trade with Miss Fortune, attack in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Activate Sivir W Ricochet right after a basic attack to take advantage of the basic attack timer reset. If you then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, move sideways so Miss Fortune also gets hit on its return path.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no ability to create distance, so look for a chance to close in from outside the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain. When Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to dodge to the side of the cone. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to increase movement speed when engaging or retreating with your allies.
MissFortune.fight: Immediately after Miss Fortune attacks a minion, create distance to avoid her empowered basic attack poke. When trading damage, activate Sivir W Ricochet right after a Sivir basic attack, then immediately land another basic attack. After landing Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to reposition.
MissFortune.laning: Stand to the side of the minion line to avoid the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up. When pushing the wave, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade through the minion line. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t use it when you’re likely to miss. If you don’t want to push the lane, don’t hit minions while Sivir W Ricochet is active.
MissFortune.phase: Early on, manage Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s mana cost while avoiding the bounce from Miss Fortune Q Double Up and her empowered basic attack poke. Sivir peaks in the midgame siege phase, so clear waves quickly and use Sivir R On The Hunt to help your allies engage or disengage.
MissFortune.teamfight: Delay your engage while Miss Fortune E Make It Rain covers an area, and draw the enemy out of it. From the back line, Sivir hits the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send the bouncing damage to the back line. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to match your allies’ engage or retreat, then keep basic attacking as the fight continues to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up bounces off the first target and hits behind it, so don’t stand directly behind a minion. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain lands, you could be slowed and hit by Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, so move out of the area. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time’s direction locks when she casts it, so dodge to the side of the cone instead of only retreating.

Samira.build: Build armor first against Samira’s main damage from Samira Q Flair, Samira W Blade Whirl, and Samira R Inferno Trigger. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Samira P Daredevil Impulse and Samira E Wild Rush.
Samira.combo: When Samira W Blade Whirl ends, attack in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move sideways to try to hit Samira on its return path too. If you activate Sivir R On The Hunt while chasing with allies, keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
Samira.escape: If Samira E Wild Rush is down and no one has died, that’s your window to attack Samira. If the enemy support’s crowd control is also down, use Sivir R On The Hunt to close the distance with your allies. Before Samira closes in again, trigger Sivir P Fleet of Foot with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to reposition.
Samira.fight: Trade damage after Samira W Blade Whirl ends or Samira E Wild Rush is down. Right after landing a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet to quickly land the next basic attack, then use Sivir P Fleet of Foot to create distance again. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to increase your engage speed when your allies go in with you.
Samira.laning: Watch Samira’s approach angle and don’t let her get into melee range. When pushing the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then line up the outgoing and returning paths of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade with the minion line. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t throw it carelessly. Save Sivir E Spell Shield for crowd control that sets up the enemy’s engage.
Samira.phase: Early on, use Samira’s short range to maintain distance while managing Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s mana cost. Sivir is good at sieging in the midgame, so push the wave and use Sivir R On The Hunt to help your allies engage or disengage.
Samira.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send damage through to Samira, and don’t waste projectiles or basic attacks while Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning. If an ally is caught by crowd control, watch that position because Samira can engage with Samira P Daredevil Impulse. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to match your allies’ engage or retreat, and don’t leave low-health allies behind when retreating.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles and basic attacks, so use Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and basic attacks after the spin ends. If you’re caught by the enemy support’s crowd control, Samira can close in with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so use Sivir E Spell Shield when the ability actually flies toward you or step back. If Samira stays close for too long, she can build style and use Samira R Inferno Trigger, so create distance again.

Senna.build: Build armor first because Senna’s main damage is physical. If the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item.
Senna.combo: When Senna comes close, land a basic attack and immediately activate Sivir W Ricochet to land another basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move sideways so Senna also gets hit on its return path.
Senna.escape: Close the distance right after Senna W Last Embrace misses or you block it with Sivir E Spell Shield. Senna has no ability to create distance herself, so hit her with a basic attack or Sivir Q Boomerang Blade to gain the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot and chase.
Senna.fight: Senna has relatively low armor, so use Sivir’s physical damage to make short trades from the start. Right after blocking Senna W Last Embrace, counterattack while repositioning with the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot.
Senna.laning: Push the wave by hitting the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet and finishing with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Anticipate where Senna will step out to collect a soul and poke her to disrupt collection. Move out of the line of Senna Q Piercing Darkness, and save Sivir E Spell Shield to block Senna W Last Embrace.
Senna.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and attack damage, so push the lane and stop her from collecting souls. Sivir is strong at sieging in the midgame, so clear the wave and move with your allies using Sivir R On The Hunt. In the late game, Senna’s range and attack damage grow, so avoid weak one-on-one duels as Sivir and group for teamfights.
Senna.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send damage through to the back line. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to an area with vision or throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade into the mist. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to match your allies’ engage or retreat, and keep basic attacking during the fight to bring forward your next chance to use your basic abilities.
Senna.watch: Senna W Last Embrace roots after a short delay, so avoid it by standing behind minions, and block it with Sivir E Spell Shield as it flies toward you. To dodge Senna Q Piercing Darkness, move out of the line between Senna and a front minion or ally. If you’ve been hit once, retreat before her second attack so she can’t get Senna P Absolution’s mist.

Seraphine.build: If the enemy’s healing is a problem, buy Executioner's Calling after one core item. Sivir W Ricochet can spread its healing reduction to several enemies. If you build resistance against Seraphine’s damage, prioritize magic resistance over armor.
Seraphine.combo: Block Seraphine E Beat Drop with Sivir E Spell Shield as it flies toward you, then counterattack immediately. Damage her with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, then reposition. For a close trade, attack in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack.
Seraphine.escape: The moment after Seraphine E Beat Drop is down is your chance to close the distance. Seraphine has no mobility, so use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot or Sivir R On The Hunt to engage then. If Seraphine E Beat Drop slows you, first move out of its line.
Seraphine.fight: Look to trade when Seraphine is separated from your allied marksman. Once Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, close the distance using the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot and Sivir R On The Hunt. Sivir has no mobility ability, so don’t force an approach while Seraphine E Beat Drop is available.
Seraphine.laning: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t use it for poke that is likely to miss. When pushing the lane, hit the front minion with Sivir W Ricochet, then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade through the minion line. If you don’t want to push the lane, don’t hit minions while Sivir W Ricochet is active.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, watch out for Seraphine’s catching abilities while managing your distance and Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s mana. Sivir is strong at sieging in the midgame, so clear waves quickly and pressure towers with your allies.
Seraphine.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet to send damage to the back line. Stand spread out to either side of your allies so Seraphine R Encore can’t extend through them. Use Sivir R On The Hunt to match your allies’ engage or retreat, then keep basic attacking during the fight to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets. If you’re slowed, move out of its path, and block Seraphine E Beat Drop with Sivir E Spell Shield as it flies toward you. In teamfights, Seraphine R Encore reaches farther each time it passes through an allied champion, so don’t stand in a line with your allies.

Tristana.combo: After Tristana W Rocket Jump is down, land a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet, then immediately land another basic attack. Throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side to catch Tristana on its return path as well.
Tristana.escape: The moment after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down is your window to engage. Don't engage recklessly while both Tristana W Rocket Jump and Tristana R Buster Shot are available. If Sivir E Spell Shield is down, don't rush in response to Tristana's engage; back away.
Tristana.fight: The moment after Tristana W Rocket Jump is down is your chance to close the distance and fight. Hit her with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, and reposition between attacks.
Tristana.laning: Tristana is weak early, so push the wave to her tower and make last-hitting difficult. Hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then clear with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, but don't throw Q aimlessly because it costs a lot of mana. Don't stand close to allied minions, so you can avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak early, so use Sivir's wave clear to pressure her tower. Sivir is strong at sieging in the mid game, so push towers with your team.
Tristana.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with basic attacks and Sivir W Ricochet, and activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team's engage or retreat. After activating R, keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. If an ally is taken down, Tristana W Rocket Jump resets and she can jump in again, so retreat together immediately.
Tristana.watch: Watch for the slow when Tristana W Rocket Jump closes the distance, and be wary of the stun and forced displacement from Tristana R Buster Shot. Don't use Sivir E Spell Shield on Tristana's initial engage; time it for when Tristana R Buster Shot is actually used.

TwistedFate.build: There isn't enough information to specify a first purchase. Build magic resistance against Twisted Fate's damage, and get movement speed to help you leave the areas where his attacks are telegraphed.
TwistedFate.combo: If you block Twisted Fate's gold card attack from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card with Sivir E Spell Shield, counterattack with a basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so the enemy is caught on its return path as well.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses his gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is your chance to approach. If he is holding a gold card, time Sivir E Spell Shield for the actual attack or keep your distance.
TwistedFate.fight: Keep your distance while Twisted Fate holds a gold card, and trade right after he uses a card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card or you block it with Sivir E Spell Shield. After a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet to land another attack immediately, then reposition using the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot after dealing damage.
TwistedFate.laning: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don't throw it aimlessly. When pushing the lane, hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade through the minion line.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, Sivir can use her fast wave clear while managing the mana cost of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade.
TwistedFate.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to carry damage through to the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt in response to your team's engage or retreat, and keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
TwistedFate.watch: When Twisted Fate is holding a gold card with Twisted Fate W Pick a Card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his attack range. Block it with Sivir E Spell Shield as the attack actually comes in, then counterattack immediately. Watch out for the area damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards too, but don't use Spell Shield early to block them.

Twitch.build: Buy a Control Ward to reveal Twitch's camouflage from Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so building only one type of resistance blocks just part of it. Resistances don't work against the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom, so consider ways to reduce total health and attack speed.
Twitch.combo: When Twitch reveals himself and attacks, land a basic attack first, activate Sivir W Ricochet, then immediately land another basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so Twitch is hit by its return path too. If you activated Sivir R On The Hunt, keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
Twitch.escape: When Twitch reveals himself from camouflage and also leaves the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask, look for a chance to close the distance with your allies. Twitch has no ability to create distance himself, but if you've already taken several basic attacks, back away first in anticipation of Twitch E Contaminate.
Twitch.fight: When Twitch reveals himself from camouflage, coordinate your target with your allies and attack together. After hitting him with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack, reposition using the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, and don't continue trading inside the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask.
Twitch.laning: If Twitch disappears from lane, alert your allies, and either check paths where there is no vision with a Control Ward or take a different route. Hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then line up Sivir Q Boomerang Blade with the minion wave to clear it. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don't throw it aimlessly.
Twitch.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to carry damage through to the backline. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, move to the side of his attack direction so you don't line up with your allies. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team's engage or retreat, and coordinate your target with your allies when Twitch reveals himself from camouflage.
Twitch.watch: When Twitch disappears from sight with Twitch Q Ambush, he may appear from the flank, so avoid bushes you have no vision of and narrow paths. Leave the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask immediately, and if you've taken several basic attacks, create distance before Twitch E Contaminate hits, even if you still have health. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, account for its increased range and don't stand in a line with your allies.

Varus.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Varus Q Piercing Arrow and Varus E Hail of Arrows. Against the max-health damage from Varus W Blighted Quiver, avoid responding by only adding large amounts of health, and consider reducing his attack speed so you take fewer basic attacks.
Varus.combo: After Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow or uses Varus R Chain of Corruption, hit him with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and use the movement speed to approach. Then attack with a basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack; W resets the basic attack timer, letting you attack twice in a short time.
Varus.escape: Approach during the window when Varus R Chain of Corruption is down. While Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge to the side of its path and look for a chance to close in. If you engage with your allies, use Sivir R On The Hunt to increase everyone's movement speed.
Varus.fight: When Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge to the side to leave the arrow's path while closing the distance. Hit him with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, and attack while repositioning. If you block Varus R Chain of Corruption with Sivir E Spell Shield, counterattack using your healing and movement speed.
Varus.laning: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so use it from an angle where it can hit, and move to the side after throwing it so its return path hits Varus too. When pushing the lane, hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then clear with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Don't use Sivir E Spell Shield for poke; save it for when Varus R Chain of Corruption actually comes toward you.
Varus.phase: Early on, Sivir has difficulty prolonging laning because of the mana cost of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, but she can push the wave quickly. Mid-game sieging is Sivir's strong phase, so push the wave and use Sivir R On The Hunt to help your allies engage or disengage.
Varus.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with basic attacks and Sivir W Ricochet to carry damage through to their backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team's engage or retreat, and after engaging, keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet. If an ally is rooted by Varus R Chain of Corruption, don't group up nearby, and create distance while Varus is empowered after contributing to a takedown.
Varus.watch: If Varus has stacked blight with basic attacks and then hits you with an ability, it triggers max-health damage, so after taking a few basic attacks, back off and wait for the stacks to expire. Varus R Chain of Corruption can spread its root to nearby allies, so block it with Sivir E Spell Shield as it comes toward you, and create distance if an ally is rooted. Healing is reduced on the ground from Varus E Hail of Arrows, so leave the area.

Vayne.build: Build armor first against the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Armor can't reduce the max-health true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so avoid choices that only add large amounts of health and consider reducing Vayne's attack speed.
Vayne.combo: Right after Vayne Q Tumble is used, trade with a basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so Vayne is caught on its return path too. If Vayne E Condemn comes toward you, block it with Sivir E Spell Shield and counterattack.
Vayne.escape: The moment after Vayne Q Tumble is used is your chance to close the distance. If Vayne E Condemn is also down, move and attack using the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot. If Vayne E Condemn is still available, don't force an engage near a wall.
Vayne.fight: Close the distance for a brief trade right after Vayne Q Tumble is used. After landing a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet and immediately land another basic attack. Reposition using the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot while staying ready for Vayne E Condemn.
Vayne.laning: Early on, hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet to bounce damage, then clear the wave with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and pressure Vayne's farm. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so check the path before throwing it. Even when pushing the lane, don't fight with your back to a wall, and save Sivir E Spell Shield for Vayne E Condemn.
Vayne.phase: Early on, use Vayne's low health and armor to push the lane and pressure her farm. In the mid game, use Sivir's strong siege and Sivir R On The Hunt to pressure towers with your team.
Vayne.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths and walls, and attack the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet from the backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team's engage or retreat.
Vayne.watch: Vayne E Condemn can stun you by knocking you into a wall, so don't fight with your back to one. Block it with Sivir E Spell Shield as Vayne E Condemn actually comes toward you.

Xayah.build: Xayah's main damage is physical, so build armor first. The available information isn't enough to determine a specific item purchase order.
Xayah.combo: Right after hitting Xayah with a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet and immediately land another basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side so its return path hits Xayah while you avoid the feathers' return path.
Xayah.escape: You can start a counterattack right after dodging the root from Xayah E Bladecaller or blocking it with Sivir E Spell Shield.
Xayah.fight: Don't fight Xayah in the same spot for long; deal damage briefly, then reposition. Hit her with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot and get out of the feathers' return path. Engage with your team when Xayah R Featherstorm is down.
Xayah.laning: Keep trades short and keep moving to the side so Xayah's feathers don't build up. When pushing the lane, hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then finish with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, but don't throw Q aimlessly given its mana cost.
Xayah.phase: Sivir can push the wave quickly early, but fighting Xayah for too long is dangerous because her feathers build up.
Xayah.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to carry damage through to the backline. If Xayah R Featherstorm is available, don't force an initial engage; after it's down, activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team's engage. Then keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and W Ricochet.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you are hit by three or more returning feathers, so move sideways immediately when feathers line up between you and Xayah. If you can't dodge their return path, time Sivir E Spell Shield for when the feathers actually fly toward you.

Yasuo.build: Build armor first because Yasuo Q Steel Tempest and Yasuo R Last Breath deal most of their damage as physical damage. Armor can't block the magic damage from Yasuo E Sweeping Blade.
Yasuo.combo: After removing the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with a basic attack, attack with a basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Activate Sivir W Ricochet right after the first basic attack, since it resets the basic attack timer. After Yasuo W Wind Wall disappears, throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move to the side to catch him on its return path too.
Yasuo.escape: The moment after the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest misses or is blocked by Sivir E Spell Shield is your chance to engage. However, Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don't chase deep just because it's been used once. Engage with your team's crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back.
Yasuo.fight: Start trading after removing the shield from Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer with one basic attack. Right after the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest misses or is blocked, use the movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot to keep your distance while attacking. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is up, save Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and reposition for an angle outside the wall.
Yasuo.laning: Manage the wave so it stays slightly pushed toward your side, reducing the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can use to dash in. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don't use it for poke that's likely to miss. When clearing the lane, hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then line up Sivir Q Boomerang Blade's outgoing and return paths with the minion line.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, manage your distance and the wave while watching for Yasuo E Sweeping Blade's approach and the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest. Sivir is strong during the mid-game siege phase, so use fast wave clear and Sivir R On The Hunt to help your allies engage or disengage.
Yasuo.teamfight: From the backline, hit the enemy frontline with Sivir W Ricochet to carry damage through to their backline. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team's engage or retreat. Dodge the tornado from Yasuo Q Steel Tempest to the side or block it with Sivir E Spell Shield, then keep basic attacking from a safe distance to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo E Sweeping Blade uses minions to close the distance, so don't assume you're safe behind minions. After Yasuo Q Steel Tempest hits twice, watch for the knock-up tornado and move sideways out of its line. Block it with Sivir E Spell Shield as the tornado actually comes toward you; don't use it early just because Yasuo is approaching.

Zeri.build: Build armor first because Zeri Q Burst Fire and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser deal most of their damage as physical damage. Armor won’t block the magic damage from Zeri P Living Battery and Zeri E Spark Surge, and Zeri R Lightning Crash deals both physical and magic damage. Zeri P Living Battery deals damage based on your maximum health and has an execute effect, so avoid choices that only give you a large amount of health.
Zeri.combo: When Zeri E Spark Surge is down, land a basic attack, activate Sivir W Ricochet, then immediately land another basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move sideways to try to hit Zeri on its return path too. In a fight where you activate Sivir R On The Hunt, keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Q and W.
Zeri.escape: The chance to engage comes right after Zeri uses Zeri E Spark Surge. If you corner her against a wall, she can use E to escape a long distance, so close the distance in open terrain. The listed abilities for Zeri have no immobilizing effects, so use whether E is down as your cue to engage.
Zeri.fight: Close the distance and trade briefly right after you make Zeri use Zeri E Spark Surge. Hit her with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, then keep moving to dodge Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Don’t overchase after Zeri activates Zeri R Lightning Crash.
Zeri.laning: Use Zeri’s short basic attack range to build a lead before core items are completed. Hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then clear the wave with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade, but don’t attack minions with W active when you don’t want to push the lane. Q costs a lot of mana, so look for a good angle before throwing it.
Zeri.phase: Zeri has little kill pressure early, so use the lane and wave to build a lead before core items are completed. Sivir is strong at sieging in the mid game, so push the wave and move with your team using Sivir R On The Hunt.
Zeri.teamfight: From the back line, Sivir should hit the enemy front line and let the damage from Sivir W Ricochet carry through to the back line. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team’s engage or retreat, and keep basic attacking during the fight to reduce the cooldowns of Q and W. If Zeri has activated Zeri R Lightning Crash and sped up, don’t chase her on foot; keep her at range.
Zeri.watch: Zeri W Ultrashock Laser slows you, and spreads out to deal more damage when it hits terrain. Don’t stand with your back to a wall or face her head-on in a narrow passage. After Zeri activates Zeri R Lightning Crash, she gets faster with each hit, so don’t chase her on foot.

Ziggs.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Ziggs’s damage. Ziggs P Short Fuse, Ziggs Q Bouncing Bomb, and Ziggs W Satchel Charge all deal magic damage, so armor won’t help against this opponent’s damage.
Ziggs.combo: After Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, trade two quick hits in this order: basic attack → Sivir W Ricochet → basic attack. Then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and move sideways to try to catch Ziggs on its return path too. If you engage with your team, activate Sivir R On The Hunt and keep basic attacking to reduce the cooldowns of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade and Sivir W Ricochet.
Ziggs.escape: The window to engage opens as soon as Ziggs’s mobility tool, Ziggs W Satchel Charge, is down. If Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield remains on your approach, don’t step on it; find another route or wait for it to disappear. Save Sivir E Spell Shield for Ziggs’s forced displacement.
Ziggs.fight: Close the distance right after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge to harass or clear the wave. Hit him with Sivir Q Boomerang Blade or a basic attack to gain movement speed from Sivir P Fleet of Foot, then keep dealing damage as you reposition. Sivir’s main source of physical damage is effective against Ziggs’s low armor.
Ziggs.laning: Hit the front minions with Sivir W Ricochet, then throw Sivir Q Boomerang Blade through the minion line to clear the wave. Sivir Q Boomerang Blade costs a lot of mana, so don’t use it for harass if it might miss. Avoid paths covered by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and look for a chance to move forward after Ziggs uses Ziggs W Satchel Charge.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, watch Sivir Q Boomerang Blade’s mana cost as you clear waves, and look for an opening after Ziggs uses a full set of abilities. Sivir is at her peak during mid-game sieges, so push the wave and use Sivir R On The Hunt to help your team engage or disengage.
Ziggs.teamfight: From the back line, hit the enemy front line with Sivir W Ricochet so its bouncing damage reaches the back line. Activate Sivir R On The Hunt to match your team’s engage or retreat, and if you engage, keep basic attacking to reduce your basic abilities’ cooldowns. Avoid paths blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, and approach with your team when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down.
Ziggs.watch: Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield slows you, making it easier to get hit by his other abilities. Go around it or wait for it to disappear. Watch for the forced displacement from Ziggs W Satchel Charge, and use Sivir E Spell Shield when the ability is actually coming your way. When you see the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb, move away from the center of the explosion even if you can’t get completely clear.
